follows.ranAtNote: not recorded: the run wrote only its per-mutant lines; its record was overwritten by run 3
follows.repairs: Both survivors were equivalent and were dropped from the set. 36-inert-allows-script: assertAttribute refuses every on* name before the allow-list, so adding onload to the list changes no outcome; replaced by 36-inert-no-unknown-reason and 36-inert-no-manifest-id. 36-map-paths-not-reserved: a draft page path containing / is refused before the reserved set is consulted, so commit 124d831c removed the map paths from the set; the refusal test stays.

review CORRECTIONS 1, 8 and 9 (commit 5cee63ae, and 432b25d5 for the narrative legend test): the map pages carry the view switch, its evidence-view target and a reading legend; an Unknown file reason this version does not name refuses the render; readRunAdvice reads under the check record bound.
